items.t: BlackRock (BLK) Seeks SEC Approval For A New ETIF Fund Structure
items.sum: BlackRock (NYSE: BLK) has asked the SEC to approve a new exchange traded interval fund, or ETIF, structure for alternatives access. The proposed wrapper aims to pair ETF style trading with interval fund redemption features for individual investors seeking alternative assets. items.sum: BlackRock has outperformed the broader market over the past year, with Wall Street analysts maintaining a strongly bullish outlook on the stock’s prospects.

items.t: BlackRock® Canada Announces Estimated 2026 Annual Reinvested Capital Gains Distributions for the iShares® ETFs
items.sum: TORONTO, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited (“BlackRock Canada”), an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE: BLK), today announced the estimated 2026 annual reinvested capital gains distributions for the iShares ETFs listed on the TSX or Cboe Canada. Please note that these are estimated capital gains amounts only, as of October 30, 2026.

items.t: BlackRock-led consortium mulls lowering Stack Infrastructure Asia offer- Bloomberg
items.sum: Investing.com-- A consortium including BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) and IFM Investors is considering lowering its offer for Stack Infrastructure’s Asia-Pacific data centers amid growing uncertainty over valuations and demand in the sector, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
